in_arabic.name: حُمَيْدَة
in_arabic.meaning: حُمَيْدَة تعني الشخصية الحميدة واللطيفة والمحبوبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: حُمَيْدَة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'حمِدَ' الذي يعني الشكر والحمد. يعتبر اسم حُمَيْدَة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة، حيث يوصف الشخص الحميد بأنه الشخص الذي يحبه الناس ويثنون عليه، ويتميز بالخصال الحميدة واللطيفة. ورد اسم حُمَيْدَة في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة، وهو اسم شائع في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الصفات الحسنة والحميدة.

data.cultural_impact: The name Humaidah holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic community, as it is derived from the Arabic word "humaid," which means "one who helps or assists." In Islamic tradition, this name is often given to girls who are known for their kindness, generosity, and willingness to help those in need. It is also a reminder of the importance of charity and selflessness in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: Paralleling its cultural significance, the spiritual significance of the name Humaidah lies in its connection to the Islamic concept of compassion and charity. The name is a reminder that every effort to help the needy and alleviate their suffering is an act of worship. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The poor person who asks will be admitted [into Paradise] before the wealthy person who does not ask" (Bukhari and Muslim). By giving this name to a child, parents are instilling the values of compassion, generosity, and kindness from a young age. Humaidah is not just a name, but a call to action to follow in the footsteps of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and help those in need. Additionally, it reminds the bearer of the name that they are also poor in their spiritual journey towards Allah, and should similarly seek His help and guidance.
